args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb. Use the full name Pellow Home Living, not "PHL" or "Covey & Lark".
- "PHL" is ambiguous: it also matches Pellucid Harbor Logistics. Filtering on "PHL" pulls in both.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows. The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". It needs relabelling to Pellow Home Living so the supervisor search isn't run twice.
- Ask: please check the saved report label and any other saved views still using the Covey & Lark name.

Thanks,
Bettina Kroll
